prompt:
Flat front-on screen design, landscape 16:9 desktop web viewport, of the PLAY SCREEN of the web app "Neckspert Play" during a series, read from 1 metre by a guitarist with busy hands. No device photo, no bezel, no hands, no perspective. Keep EXACTLY the composition, layout and system grammar of the reference image; change ONLY the palette.

Structure, in order: flat matte letterbox bands fill the full 16:9 viewport; centred in them, a single game-screen frame with a true 10:9 ratio (160x144 logical pixels, slightly wider than tall, not square), integer-scaled, filling nearly the full viewport height, hugged by a 1-scaled-pixel border. Inside the frame, locked to an 8x8 tile grid, three stacked regions:
1. Top window (thin, about one sixth of frame height): a double-line border box containing, left, "MESURE 2/2" in an 8x8 pixel cap font; centre-right, a small pixel heart sprite; then "TEMPS 3/4" followed by exactly FOUR square beat pips, three filled and the fourth hollow.
2. Centre field (dominant, about two thirds of frame height): a checkerboard dither band as background; a giant blocky pixel letter "F" built from whole square tiles, occupying most of the field height, with a one-tile shade drop shadow offset down-right and a dithered halo edge; beneath it "corde de B" in the pixel font at double scale, lowercase as written.
3. Bottom window (about one sixth of frame height): an INVERTED box, solid ink fill with ground-colour text, split by a vertical rule: "PARFAIT" large on the left; on the right, two lines "+12 ms" and "0,84 s".

Palette, strictly four flat tones inside the frame, no others:
- ground #E99568 (peach-amber) - frame background and lightest dither tone
- midtone #BE6754 (burnt orange-red) - dither checker, borders of secondary boxes
- shade #813B2A (brown-red) - the F drop shadow, dither halo, inner rules
- ink #451218 (deep oxblood) - all text, the F, the heart, filled pips, box borders, inverted bottom box fill
Any fifth tone only as a checkerboard dither of two of these. Outside the frame: flat matte hardware black #1E1B1B letterbox bands, with a 1-scaled-pixel #451218 border hugging the frame. No other colours anywhere.

Rendering: crisp square pixels, hard edges, no anti-aliasing, no blur, hierarchy only by border boxes, pixel type scale and inversion.

Text, exactly and only (French): "MESURE 2/2", "TEMPS 3/4", "corde de B", "PARFAIT", "+12 ms", "0,84 s", and the letter "F". No other words.

Avoid: any guitar imagery (no wood grain, no quilt or maple texture, no guitar shapes, strings, picks, amps, flames), green tones, neon glow, bloom, CRT scanlines, gradients, vignettes, confetti, badges, XP, score, streaks, navigation, logos.
 Post-process: colours snapped to the measured Bonfire palette (#E99568 ground, #BE6754 mid, #813B2A shade, #451218 ink, #1E1B1B letterbox) with .impeccable/tools/recolor.py.
